news.title: Cornell president defends handling of alleged gang rape case
news.summary: Cornell President Michael Kotlikoff acknowledged missteps made by himself and the university when Jane Doe originally came forward with sexual assault allegations in 2024 but defended actions taken since and his role as president in an interview with The New York Times. Kotlikoff said he learned about the alleged gang rape on campus in November…
